rulings.model: The Schedule SE instructions say to "Enter the combined SE tax on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 4" and support summing over spouses. However, the Schedule SE form itself is not provided, so nothing confirms that Schedule SE line 12 is the self-employment tax amount.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; restatement accepted. Schedule SE line 12 is 'Self-employment tax. Add lines 10 and 11. Enter here and on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 4' (f1040sse, line 12); on a joint return each spouse's line 12 is summed (i1040sse, 'enter the combined SE tax on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 4').
